name: Order Management & Fulfillment Domain Practices
description: Exhaustive business-domain knowledge pack for order management and fulfillment, covering quote-to-order conversion, order validation, credit checks, inventory reservation, order fulfillment routing, backorder tracking, cancellations, and return merchandise authorizations (RMA).

checklists.name: Order Management & Fulfillment Audit Checklist
checklists.description: Validation checklist for order validation, inventory allocation, fulfillment tracking, and RMA return handling.

items.statement: Sales quotes are validated for pricing, discount approvals, and tax calculation prior to order conversion.
Customer credit balance check prevents order release if exposure exceeds credit limit.
Inventory hard reservation assigns available stock to order lines without double allocation.
Backordered items trigger automated customer notifications and estimated restock fulfillment dates.
Returned items under RMA undergo quality inspection before issuing customer credit memos.

reviewGates.name: Order Operations Review Gate
reviewGates.statement: The Order Operations Manager confirms that credit validation, inventory reservation, and RMA workflows function properly.
reviewGates.prompt: Does the order management workflow satisfy fulfillment accuracy and credit control rules?
